name: PayKhata
desc: An offline payroll and employee-record app built for a local garment shop. Salary, advances, loans and receipts — together in one practical tool.
problem: Employee payments were recorded in a notebook, making salary, advance and loan records difficult to follow.
approach: Built individual employee profiles, payment histories, separate loan and repayment records, and monthly and yearly PDF reports.
result: Delivered to a local shop owner. Runs offline, with digital receipts and manual backup and recovery.

name: Ereal Cloud
line: A digital home for a software business.
desc: A software-company website that brings services, project work and enquiries into a clear, professional experience.
problem: Present a software company’s services and work in a cohesive online presence.
approach: Created a responsive company website with service sections and an admin interface using Firebase Authentication and Firestore.
result: Published on Firebase Hosting, with a content structure for services, portfolio, blog and contact.

name: MiniTracker
desc: An offline daily expense tracker with quick entry, spending history, monthly budgets and CSV export.
problem: Everyday expenses are easy to forget and difficult to review when scattered across notes.
approach: Designed quick expense entry, category organisation, monthly budget tracking and a dashboard, backed by local SQLite storage.
result: An Android app designed to work without a backend, ads or subscriptions. Includes light and dark themes.

name: FK Fabrics
line: From the cloth house to the web.
desc: An online storefront for a family fabric business, connecting a local shop with a digital product experience.
problem: Give a local fabric shop an online home for its products.
approach: Built a React and Firebase storefront, with ongoing website and product-content work.
result: A live e-commerce project for Fazal Khaliq Cloth House in Quaidabad.

name: AI Habit Coach
desc: Fitness and badminton habit tracking with AI-assisted guidance.
problem: Bring badminton training, fitness habits and guidance into one experience.
approach: Combined a mobile interface, Firebase-backed data and an AI API for a university final-year project.
result: A capstone project exploring habit tracking and AI suggestions. Public demo not available.

name: PlastiZero
line: A clearer view of a complex problem.
desc: An interactive awareness website exploring plastic pollution and ways to take action.
problem: Make environmental information easier to navigate and act on.
approach: Created interactive page views for issues, solutions and participation.
result: An included frontend demonstration. Its illustrative contact form does not send messages.
